experiment: X3-A-O7 (frozen-data sensitivity analysis; secondary robustness evidence)
note: Expected hashes below were copied from the pre-existing frozen record research/analysis/RESULT_HASHES_phase3.txt and from research/locks/*.sha256-tracked lock files, and are NOT computed from mutable files at run time. This artifact must be committed and tagged together with x3a_o7.py before any official run; the script refuses to run officially unless both are clean against HEAD.

registration_tag.name: prereg/X3-A-O7/v1
tag_message_format: registration-commit: <full 40-hex commit SHA that the tag points to>
registration-sha256: <SHA-256 of this file's bytes at the tagged commit>
script-sha256: <SHA-256 of research/analysis/x3a_o7/x3a_o7.py bytes at the tagged commit>
registration_tag.note: A commit cannot contain its own SHA, so the registered full commit SHA is recorded in the immutable annotated tag message and must also be supplied at run time with --registered-commit. An official run requires: tag exists, is annotated, resolves to that commit, HEAD equals that commit exactly, and this file and x3a_o7.py are byte-identical to their blobs at the tag.

upstream_manifests.role: X3-A analysis manifest (produced x3a_decision.json; its legacy gate object is empty, finding M3, so no gate can be required)
